requirements.general: Any one of these: SPM: Minimum 3Cs. O-Level: Minimum 3Cs (including a Science subject and pass in English). UEC: Minimum 3Bs (including a Science subject and pass in English). Certificate / SKM III: Minimum CGPA of 2.00 with a C in SPM. Other Qualifications: As recognised by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to SPM. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT (INTERNATIONAL):  IELTS - 5 TOEFL (PBT) - 410 TOEFL (IBT) - 42 PTE - 47 MUET - BAND 3 Cambridge English - 154
